title: ARG Dependency Graph
description: Cryptographic allow list restricting which external models, endpoints, and cloud resource paths an execution tree is authorized to call

graph_id.description: Unique identifier for this dependency graph definition

version.description: Semantic version of this graph definition

allowed_models.description: List of model identifiers the execution tree is authorized to call

allowed_endpoints.description: List of external endpoints the execution tree is authorized to call

blocked_endpoints.description: Explicit block list. Takes precedence over allowed_endpoints.
